fel-icon-of-the-tainted.name: Fel Icon of The Tainted
fel-icon-of-the-tainted.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly THE TAINTED units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

lord-of-nurgle.name: Lord of Nurgle
lord-of-nurgle.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly DEATH GUARD units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

lords-of-the-plague-host.name: Lords of the Plague Host
lords-of-the-plague-host.text: If this unit is in a Detachment that contains only DEATH GUARD units, its Battlefield Role is Troops instead of Elites.

arch-sorceror-of-the-tainted.name: Arch-Sorceror of the Tainted
arch-sorceror-of-the-tainted.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly THE TAINTED units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

prince-of-nurgle.name: Prince of Nurgle
prince-of-nurgle.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly DEATH GUARD and NURGLE DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

host-of-the-destroyer-hive.name: Host of the Destroyer Hive
host-of-the-destroyer-hive.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly POXWALKER units whilst they are within 7" of this unit.

pestilential-fallout.name: Pestilential Fallout
pestilential-fallout.text: When this unit is selected to manifest a psychic power, after resolving its effects, if there are any enemy units within 7" of this unit, roll one D12; on a 7+ place one blast marker next to the closest enemy unit to this unit. If multiple enemy units are equally close, select one and place one blast marker next to it instead.

mindless.name: Mindless
mindless.text: Morale tests taken for this unit are automatically passed.

diseased-horde.name: Diseased Horde
diseased-horde.text: If this unit contains 20 models, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit.

cloud-of-flies.name: Cloud of Flies
cloud-of-flies.text: If this unit contains 30 models, it is always an obscured target.

tocsin-of-misery.name: Tocsin of Misery
tocsin-of-misery.text: If a DEATH GUARD unit starts a Move action within 7" of any friendly units with this ability, add 2" to that unit’s Move characteristic for that action.

revolting-stench.name: Revolting Stench
revolting-stench.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by enemy units that target this unit.

blight-racks.name: Blight Racks
blight-racks.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons by DEATH GUARD PLAGUE MARINE units whilst they are within 3" of any friendly units with this ability.

tainted-narthecium.name: Tainted Narthecium
tainted-narthecium.text: Re-roll Ignore Damage rolls of 1 made for friendly DEATH GUARD INFANTRY units whilst they are within 3" of this unit.

the-seven-fold-chant.name: The Seven-Fold Chant
the-seven-fold-chant.text: If any friendly units with this ability are on the battlefield at the start of the Generate Command Assets step, roll a D12; on a 10+ you generate one extra Command Asset.

festering-zealot.name: Festering Zealot
festering-zealot.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly DEATH GUARD units whilst they are within 7" of this unit.

silent-bodyguard.name: Silent Bodyguard
silent-bodyguard.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that CHARACTER unit and place them next to this unit.

putrescent-fog.name: Putrescent Fog
putrescent-fog.text: LIGHT DEATH GUARD units are always obscured targets whilst they are wholly within 7" of any friendly units with this ability.

foul-stench.name: Foul Stench
foul-stench.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by enemy units that target this unit.

tri-lobe.name: Tri-lobe
tri-lobe.text: If this unit contains 3 models, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit.

the-barbaran-plate.name: The Barbaran Plate
the-barbaran-plate.text: This unit does not suffer the penalty for being critically damaged.

primarch-of-the-death-guard.name: Primarch of the Death Guard
primarch-of-the-death-guard.text: You can re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by friendly DEATH GUARD units whilst they are within 7" of this unit.

host-of-plagues.name: Host of Plagues
host-of-plagues.text: At the end of the Action phase, roll a D12 for each enemy unit within 7" of this unit; on a 10+ place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.

nurgles-gift.name: Nurgle's Gift
nurgles-gift.text: At the end of the Action phase, roll a D12 for each unit within 7" of any enemy units with this ability; on a 12 place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.
